subject: general
question: Dandari (Dancing) troupes perform __________ during the festival of Diwali for a fortnight with participation from Kolam and Raj Gond tribes.
solution:
The correct answer is **Ghusadi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghusadi** is a traditional dance performed by the Kolam and Raj Gond tribes.
 
• This dance is specifically associated with the festival of **Diwali**.
 
• The performance lasts for a **fortnight** during the Diwali festival.
 
• Dandari troupes, consisting of members from these tribes, participate in this vibrant dance form.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 Details
 
 

 Chhau
 Chhau is a semi-classical Indian dance with martial, tribal, and folk origins from Odisha, Jharkhand, and West Bengal.
 
 

 Baiga Pardhoni
 Baiga Pardhoni is a traditional dance of the Baiga tribe, known for its unique rhythmic movements and cultural significance.
 
 

 Ghusadi
 Ghusadi is a dance performed by Kolam and Raj Gond tribes during Diwali, involving elaborate costumes and energetic moves.
 
 

 Rout Nacha
 Rout Nacha is a traditional dance of the tribal communities in Chhattisgarh, often performed during local festivals and celebrations.
